newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates quoted steady to lower on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates quoted steady to lower on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at steady to lower levels on Tuesday at the St. Louis Merchants Exchange. No barges traded versus 22 on Monday.
- Two barges this week, Mississippi(Osceola through Cairo) offered 10 points lower at 115 percent of tariff, no bid.
- One barge this week lower Ohio bid five points lower at 130 percent, offered at 140 percent.
- Four barges, two each weeks of February 19 and 26, Mississippi River (St. Louis) bid at 120 percent, unchanged from previous trade, no offer.
